title: RAGFlow — Document Understanding, Agentic Retrieval & Knowledge Compilation
resourceType: Open-source RAG and agentic retrieval platform
purpose: 將複雜文件、掃描內容、表格與多來源資料解析、切塊、索引、檢索，提供具來源引用的知識問答與 Agent context layer。
recommendation: 適合評估企業知識庫、私有文件檢索、Agentic RAG 與可追溯引用；特別值得研究 document parsing、chunk visualization、hybrid recall/reranking、Knowledge Compilation。自架建議先核對官方 Docker 環境需求與模型成本。
notes: README describes document parsing, explainable chunking, multi-round agentic retrieval, grounded citations, and knowledge compilation into Wikis/Graphs/Trees/PageIndex/Mind Maps/Timelines/Skills. 2026-09-29 announced 1.0.0-rc1 Go release. Treat as platform Resource, not as one reusable Skill.
